vocab.sentence: This website contains lots of information about the K-pop band.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個網站包含許多關於這個韓國流行樂團的資訊。

vocab.sentence: If I knew this term, I could explain it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果我知道這個用語，我就能解釋它。

vocab.sentence: If I had a small amount of salt, I could make soup.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果我有少量的鹽，我就能煮湯。

vocab.sentence: Frank told me too many secrets at one time. It was hard to digest all.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Frank 一次告訴我太多祕密，很難全部消化。

vocab.sentence: If I had more money, I would buy a variety of books.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果我有更多錢，我就會買各式各樣的書。

vocab.sentence: Lucy is going to see the latest British film at a new theater.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Lucy 打算去一家新電影院看最新的英國電影。

vocab.sentence: I love this novel because the development of its plot is very good.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我喜歡這本小說，因為它的情節發展非常好。

vocab.sentence: Jessie and I have a lot in common. There is no doubt that we will become good friends.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Jessie 和我有許多共同點，毫無疑問，我們會成為好朋友。

vocab.sentence: The plot of this movie was too complicated, so I had to watch it again.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這部電影的情節太複雜，所以我得再看一次。

vocab.sentence: If our school changed this policy, we could use phones at lunch.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果我們學校改變這項政策，我們就能在午餐時間使用手機。

vocab.sentence: If you explained it, there would be no misunderstanding.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果你解釋這件事，就不會有誤會。

vocab.sentence: This LINE creator has uploaded some funny stickers, and they have become very popular.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位 LINE 創作者上傳了一些有趣的貼圖，而這些貼圖變得非常受歡迎。

vocab.sentence: Charlotte has a preference for five-toe socks rather than normal ones.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 比起一般襪子，Charlotte 更喜歡五趾襪。

vocab.sentence: The article presents a balanced view of the latest debates in society.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這篇文章對社會上最新的爭議提出周全的觀點。

vocab.sentence: If the game were risky, I would not play it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果這個遊戲有危險，我就不會玩。

vocab.sentence: If buses were more frequent, I could get home earlier.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果公車班次更頻繁，我就能早一點到家。

phrases.sentence: It never crossed my mind that I would work for NASA one day.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我從沒想過，有一天我會為 NASA 工作。

phrases.sentence: Rick and I haven’t seen each other for a long time, so we naturally have a lot to catch up on.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Rick 和我很久沒見了，所以自然有許多近況要聊。

phrases.sentence: Although the two pictures looked similar, Shelly could still tell them apart.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 雖然這兩張圖片看起來很相似，Shelly 仍然能分辨它們。

phrases.sentence: This hot pot is still boiling. Without a doubt, it is very hot right now.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 這鍋火鍋還在沸騰，毫無疑問，現在非常燙。

phrases.sentence: I rely on my friends for support when I am depressed.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我感到沮喪時，會依靠朋友的支持。

phrases.sentence: Thanks for your advice. I’ll be sure to keep it in mind.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 謝謝你的建議，我一定會記在心裡。

tips.label: 假設現在不同
tips.text: If + 主詞 + 過去式，主詞 + would／could／might + 原形動詞。這裡的過去式表示假設，不是在描述過去。

tips.label: 假設句的 be 動詞
tips.text: 本課正式假設語氣，不論主詞是 I、he、she 或其他人稱，都用 were：If I were you, ...

tips.label: 否定也要用原形
tips.text: if 子句：did not + 原形動詞；主句：would not／could not + 原形動詞。be 動詞的否定用 were not。

tips.label: 受詞被做某件事
tips.text: have／make + 受詞 + 過去分詞。例如 have the door repaired，門是被修理的。

tips.label: 先判斷誰做動作
tips.text: have Ben fix the bike：Ben 修車。have the bike fixed：車被修。make myself understood：讓別人理解我的意思。

notes.title: 與現在事實相反的假設
notes.rule: If + S + 過去式, S + would／could／might／should + 原形動詞
notes.description: 想像現在與事實不同的情況時，if 子句用過去式，主句用過去式情態助動詞加原形動詞。例如現在不知道某個用語，卻假設自己知道。would 表示會，could 表示能，might 表示可能；課本亦列 should，但使用時仍須配合語意，不是四個字可任意互換。
examples: I do not know this term. If I knew it, I could explain it.（我不知道這個用語。如果我知道，就能解釋它。）
If the buses were more frequent, we would not wait so long.（如果公車班次更頻繁，我們就不會等這麼久。）

notes.title: 正式假設語氣的 were
notes.rule: If + S + were／were not + 補語, S + would／could／might + V
notes.description: 本課依課本正式用法，所有人稱的 be 動詞都用 were；were not 可縮寫成 weren’t。a student 等身分、free 等狀態，都可以放在 were 後面。口語中某些主詞也可能搭配 was，因此本題庫不把 was 與 were 同列，避免學生遇到兩個合理選項。
examples: If I were you, I would ask the teacher.（如果我是你，我會問老師。）
If the job weren’t risky, I would try it.（如果這份工作沒有危險，我會試試看。）

notes.title: 否定句與子句位置
notes.rule: If + S + did not + V, S + would not／could not + V；S + would + V + if + S + 過去式
notes.description: 一般動詞的否定是 did not 加原形，不能寫 didn’t went；主句的 would not 後面也接原形。if 子句放前面時，後面加逗號；放在主句後面時通常不用逗號。只改變子句位置，不改變動詞規則。
examples: If he didn’t rely on us so much, he would learn more.（如果他不那麼依賴我們，他就會學到更多。）
I would watch the film if I had time.（如果我有時間，我就會看這部電影。）
If I were you, I would not take that risky job.（如果我是你，我不會接受那份有危險的工作。）

notes.title: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞
notes.rule: 主詞 + have／has／had／will have + 受詞 + 過去分詞
notes.description: 表示請人或安排把某件事做好。受詞是動作的承受者，所以後方用過去分詞。時態由 have 的形式表示；即使前面是 will have，受詞後仍要用過去分詞。by + 人可指出執行者，也可以省略。
examples: We will have the classroom door repaired.（我們會請人修理教室的門。）
She had the package sent to her house.（她請人把包裹寄到她家。）
They had the chairs fixed by a worker.（他們請工人修好了椅子。）

notes.title: make + 受詞 + 過去分詞
notes.rule: make + O + Vpp；make oneself heard／understood／seen；make something known
notes.description: 受詞和後面的動作形成被動關係。myself／herself／ourselves 可以表示自己被看見，或自己的聲音、意思被聽見與理解。make 與 have 的語意及自然搭配不同，不能把所有例句的 make 和 have 任意互換。此處不是將整句的使役動詞改為被動語態。
examples: She spoke loudly to make herself heard.（她大聲說話，讓別人聽見她的聲音。）
I used a picture to make myself understood.（我用圖片讓別人理解我的意思。）
The teacher made the new policy known to the class.（老師讓全班知道新政策。）

notes.title: 主動還是被動，要看受詞與動作的關係
notes.rule: make／have + 動作執行者 + 原形動詞；make／have + 動作承受者 + 過去分詞
notes.description: 不能只用「人接原形、物接過去分詞」死記，因為人也可能承受動作。先問：受詞自己做這個動作，還是這個動作發生在受詞身上？再選原形或過去分詞。注意不規則過去分詞：send → sent、hear → heard、see → seen、write → written、know → known、understand → understood、make → made；read、cut、put 的原形與過去分詞拼法相同。
examples: I had Ben fix the bike.（我請 Ben 修車；Ben 執行修理動作。）
I had the bike fixed.（我請人修車；車承受修理動作。）
The teacher made us read the policy.（老師要我們閱讀政策；我們執行閱讀動作。）
We tried to make ourselves understood.（我們試著讓別人理解我們的意思；這裡仍用過去分詞。）

quiz.question: I do not know this term. If I ___ its meaning, I could explain the rule.
quiz.hint: 前句說現在不知道這個用語；假設現在知道時，if 子句用 know 的過去式 knew。

quiz.question: The classroom door is broken. We will have it ___ before class.
quiz.hint: it 指門，門是被修理的對象；have + 受詞 + 過去分詞，所以用 repaired。will 不會讓受詞後的動詞改成原形。

quiz.question: This website has very little information. If it ___ more facts, I could finish my report.
quiz.hint: 網站目前資料很少；想像相反情況時，if 子句用 contained，不用現在式 contains。

quiz.question: The room was noisy. The teacher spoke loudly to make herself ___.
quiz.hint: 老師提高音量是要讓自己的聲音被聽見，使用 make herself heard；herself 不是聽別人的人。

quiz.question: The two pictures look the same. If their colors ___ different, I could tell them apart.
quiz.hint: 現在顏色相同，假設顏色不同時用 were；could tell 也提示這是相反假設。

quiz.question: The creator asked the printer for help. She had her pictures ___ on cards.
quiz.hint: pictures 是被印在卡片上的圖片；had + 受詞 + 過去分詞，使用 printed。

quiz.question: He relies on his parents for everything. If he ___ on them so much, he would learn more.
quiz.hint: 現在他很依賴父母；假設他不這麼依賴，if 子句的否定用 did not + 原形 rely。

quiz.question: My explanation was complicated, so I drew pictures to make myself ___.
quiz.hint: 畫圖是為了讓別人理解我的意思，因此用 make myself understood；不是讓自己去理解某物。

quiz.question: I do not have a copy of the film. If I ___ one, we could watch it together.
quiz.hint: 前句說現在沒有影片；與現在相反的 if 假設句用 have 的過去式 had。

quiz.question: The old policy is only in English. We will have it ___ into Chinese.
quiz.hint: it 指政策文字，是被翻譯成中文的對象；受詞後使用過去分詞 translated。

quiz.question: The rule is complicated. If it were simpler, everyone could ___ it.
quiz.hint: could 是情態助動詞，後面接原形 understand；不能再接過去式或 -ing 形式。

quiz.question: My brother knows how to fix bikes. I will have him ___ mine.
quiz.hint: him 指哥哥或弟弟，是執行修車的人；have + 人 + 原形動詞，所以用 fix。不要把本題當成車被修的結構。

quiz.question: Buses do not come often here. If there ___ more frequent buses, we could leave later.
quiz.hint: 實際班次不頻繁，假設班次更多時，there be 的 be 改用 were；後面是複數 buses。

quiz.question: The driver had the risky road ___ by an expert before using it.
quiz.hint: road 是被專家檢查的對象；by an expert 指出執行者，因此用過去分詞 checked。

quiz.question: I am only a viewer. If I were the creator of this film, I ___ its ending.
quiz.hint: 前句表明我不是創作者；相反假設的主句用 would + 原形 change。will 不合此句設定，另外兩項的動詞形式錯誤。

quiz.question: The teacher wants everyone to know the new policy. She will make it ___ to the class.
quiz.hint: it 指政策，是要被全班知道的內容；make + 受詞 + known 表示使內容為人所知。

quiz.question: If I were you, I would not ___ such a risky job.
quiz.hint: would not 後仍接原形 take；否定詞 not 不會讓後面的動詞改成過去式。

quiz.question: The package is ready. Please have it ___ to my house.
quiz.hint: package 是被寄送的物品；send 的過去分詞是 sent，所以用 have it sent。

quiz.question: She does not have my number. If she ___ it, she could call me about the misunderstanding.
quiz.hint: 她現在沒有我的電話號碼；假設她有時，if 子句用 had，後面的 could call 表示假設結果。

quiz.question: The teacher made us ___ the complicated sentence again.
quiz.hint: us 是執行閱讀的學生；主動使役結構 make + 人 + 原形動詞，不加 to，所以選 read。

quiz.question: I am sure about the answer. I would ask the teacher if I ___ unsure.
quiz.hint: 現在很確定，卻假設不確定；if 子句即使放後面，正式假設語氣仍用 were。

quiz.question: The hall is dark. I will stand under the light to make myself ___.
quiz.hint: 站到燈下是要讓自己被別人看見，使用 make myself seen；see 的過去分詞是 seen。

quiz.question: Our school allows phones at lunch. If the policy ___ phone use, we would leave them at home.
quiz.hint: 現在允許使用手機；假設政策改為禁止時，if 子句用過去式 banned。

quiz.question: The film creator had the final scene ___ again yesterday.
quiz.hint: scene 是被拍攝的場景，使用 had + 受詞 + 過去分詞 filmed。yesterday 說明過去時間，但受詞後用分詞的理由是被動關係。

quiz.question: You often forget the advice. If you ___ it in mind, you would make fewer mistakes.
quiz.hint: 經常忘記是現況；假設記得建議，keep 要用過去式 kept。這題考動詞變化，片語只是素材。

quiz.question: I have a painful tooth. I will have it ___ out tomorrow.
quiz.hint: it 指牙齒，是被拔除的對象；have + 受詞 + pulled out。tomorrow 決定 will have，受詞後仍用過去分詞。

quiz.question: The creator is too busy to visit us. If she ___ more free time, she would come to our school.
quiz.hint: 她現在太忙；假設有更多時間時，if 子句的 have 改為 had，不依 she 使用 has。

quiz.question: The students could not understand the term. The teacher had the helper ___ it again.
quiz.hint: the helper 是執行解釋的人；have + 執行者 + 原形動詞，用 explain。had 是過去式，不代表其後也要用 explained。

quiz.question: The report is difficult. If it used simpler terms, I might ___ the information more easily.
quiz.hint: might 後接原形 digest；前面的 used 是 if 子句動詞，不會讓主句也接過去式。

quiz.question: The bus company had the new timetable ___ at every stop.
quiz.hint: timetable 是被張貼的時刻表，受詞後用過去分詞 posted。

quiz.question: She speaks too fast. If she ___ more slowly, we would understand her.
quiz.hint: 說太快是現況；假設她說慢一點，if 子句用 speak 的過去式 spoke。

quiz.question: The artist had a large amount of paint ___ to her studio.
quiz.hint: paint 是被送到工作室的物品，不是運送者；have + 受詞 + 過去分詞 delivered。

quiz.question: The plot is confusing. If the writer did not ___ so many names, I could follow the story.
quiz.hint: did not 已表示假設子句所需的過去形式，後面的主要動詞要還原成 use，不能寫 did not used。

quiz.question: There was a misunderstanding about the meeting. We had the time ___ again by the office.
quiz.hint: time 是被辦公室再次確認的內容；by the office 指出執行者，所以用 confirmed。

quiz.question: We only sell bread. If we sold a wider variety of food, more people ___ here.
quiz.hint: 目前只賣麵包，if we sold 想像不同情況；主句用 would + 原形 eat。

quiz.question: To keep the advice in mind, I had it ___ on a card.
quiz.hint: it 指建議，是被寫在卡片上的內容；write 的過去分詞是 written。

quiz.question: I cannot remember the two plots. If I ___ them, I could tell the films apart.
quiz.hint: 現在記不得情節；假設記得時，if 子句用過去式 remembered。

quiz.question: We will have the names ___ on the pictures so students can tell them apart.
quiz.hint: names 是被放到圖片上的名字；需用 put 的過去分詞 put。put 的原形與過去分詞拼法相同，不能依一般變化加 -ed。

quiz.question: He has little free time. If he were free, he could ___ up on his reading.
quiz.hint: could 後面接原形 catch；不是選片語意思，也不能因假設句而把 catch 改成 caught。

quiz.question: The coach made the players ___ to his advice.
quiz.hint: players 是聽建議的人；主動使役結構 make + 執行者 + 原形動詞，用 listen。

quiz.question: We do not need much water. If we ___ a large amount, we would need a bigger tank.
quiz.hint: 前句說現在不需要很多水；假設相反情況時，if 子句用過去式 needed。

quiz.question: The school had the broken chairs ___ last week.
quiz.hint: chairs 是被修理的椅子，使用過去分詞 fixed。fixes 是第三人稱單數現在式，不能放在這個受詞後當被動補語。

quiz.question: I have no preference now. If I ___ a preference, I would tell you.
quiz.hint: 現在沒有偏好；假設有偏好時用 had。主句的 would tell 與相反假設配合。

quiz.question: The creator wants to share her new film. She will have it ___ at school.
quiz.hint: it 指電影，是被放映給大家看的對象；show 的過去分詞 shown 放在受詞後。

quiz.question: This plan is risky. If it ___ so risky, I would try it.
quiz.hint: 計畫現在有風險；假設沒有這麼危險時，正式假設語氣的 be 否定用 were not。

quiz.question: We need a variety of cakes for the party. Dad will have them ___ by a baker.
quiz.hint: them 指蛋糕，是被麵包師傅製作的；by a baker 指出執行者，用 make 的過去分詞 made。

quiz.question: Her phone contains many photos. If it contained no photos, she would not ___ worried about losing them.
quiz.hint: would not 後面的 be 動詞必須用原形 be；主詞是 she 也不能改用 is。

quiz.question: The speaker wants people in the back to hear his idea. He will make it ___.
quiz.hint: it 指講者的想法，是被後方聽眾聽見的內容；make + 受詞 + heard。

quiz.question: I know very little about the story. I could enjoy the film more if I ___ more about its plot.
quiz.hint: 現在對劇情所知不多；後置的 if 子句仍用過去式 knew，known 是過去分詞，不能單獨放在這裡。

quiz.question: My bedroom walls look old. I will have them ___ white.
quiz.hint: them 指牆壁，是被漆成白色的對象；have + 受詞 + painted，white 補充漆完的顏色。

vocab.sentence: This website contains lots of information about the K-pop band.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個網站包含許多關於這個韓國流行樂團的資訊。

vocab.sentence: If I knew this term, I could explain it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果我知道這個用語，我就能解釋它。

vocab.sentence: If I had a small amount of salt, I could make soup.

vocab.sentence: This LINE creator has uploaded some funny stickers, and they have become very popular.

vocab.sentence: The article presents a balanced view of the latest debates in society.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這篇文章對社會上最新的爭議提出周全的觀點。

vocab.sentence: If the game were risky, I would not play it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果這個遊戲有危險，我就不會玩。

vocab.sentence: If buses were more frequent, I could get home earlier.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 如果公車班次更頻繁，我就能早一點到家。

phrases.sentence: It never crossed my mind that I would work for NASA one day.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我從沒想過，有一天我會為 NASA 工作。

phrases.sentence: Rick and I haven’t seen each other for a long time, so we naturally have a lot to catch up on.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Rick 和我很久沒見了，所以自然有許多近況要聊。

phrases.sentence: Although the two pictures looked similar, Shelly could still tell them apart.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 雖然這兩張圖片看起來很相似，Shelly 仍然能分辨它們。

phrases.sentence: This hot pot is still boiling. Without a doubt, it is very hot right now.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 這鍋火鍋還在沸騰，毫無疑問，現在非常燙。

phrases.sentence: I rely on my friends for support when I am depressed.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我感到沮喪時，會依靠朋友的支持。

phrases.sentence: Thanks for your advice. I’ll be sure to keep it in mind.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 謝謝你的建議，我一定會記在心裡。

grammar.sentence: If I knew the term, I could explain it.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果我知道這個用語，我就能解釋它。

grammar.sentence: We had the old classroom door repaired yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們昨天請人修好了教室的舊門。

grammar.sentence: If buses were frequent, we could leave later.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果公車班次頻繁，我們就能晚一點出發。

grammar.sentence: She spoke loudly to make her voice heard.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她大聲說話，讓別人聽見她的聲音。

grammar.sentence: I would watch the film if I were free.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果我有空，我就會看這部電影。

grammar.sentence: The creator had her pictures printed on cards.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位創作者請人把她的圖片印在卡片上。

grammar.sentence: If the plot were simple, I could follow it.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果情節簡單，我就能看懂。

grammar.sentence: He drew a picture to make himself understood.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他畫了一張圖，讓別人理解他的意思。

grammar.sentence: If I were you, I would avoid risky jobs.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果我是你，我會避開有危險的工作。

grammar.sentence: We will have the school policy translated tomorrow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們明天會請人翻譯學校政策。

grammar.sentence: If she needed support, she could rely on me.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果她需要支持，她就能依靠我。

grammar.sentence: The teacher had the helper explain the term.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 老師請助手解釋這個用語。

grammar.sentence: If I kept notes, I would remember the advice.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果我有記筆記，我就會記得這個建議。

grammar.sentence: We waved our flags to make ourselves seen.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們揮動旗子，讓別人看見我們。

grammar.sentence: If he spoke slowly, there would be no misunderstanding.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果他說得慢一點，就不會有誤會。

grammar.sentence: My brother had his broken bike fixed yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我哥哥昨天請人修好了他壞掉的腳踏車。

grammar.sentence: If the plan weren’t risky, I would try it.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果這個計畫沒有危險，我就會試試看。

grammar.sentence: The club had a variety of cakes made.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這個社團請人製作了各式各樣的蛋糕。

grammar.sentence: If I had money, I would buy the film.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果我有錢，我就會買這部電影。

grammar.sentence: We had the timetable posted at every bus stop.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們請人在每個公車站張貼時刻表。

grammar.sentence: I could help if I knew your preference.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果我知道你的偏好，我就能幫忙。

grammar.sentence: The teacher made the students read the policy.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 老師要學生閱讀這項政策。

grammar.sentence: If the box contained glass, I would carry it carefully.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果盒子裡有玻璃，我就會小心搬運它。

grammar.sentence: She had the letters sent to her friends.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她請人把信寄給她的朋友。

grammar.sentence: If I had time, I could digest the news.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果我有時間，我就能消化這個消息。

grammar.sentence: We will have the mistake in the report corrected.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們會請人更正報告中的錯誤。

grammar.sentence: If the twins wore different hats, I could tell them apart.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果這對雙胞胎戴不同的帽子，我就能分辨他們。

grammar.sentence: The creator will have her new film shown.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位創作者會安排放映她的新電影。

grammar.sentence: If the policy changed, more students could join.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 如果政策改變，就會有更多學生能參加。

grammar.sentence: I had the key points written on cards.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我請人把重點寫在卡片上。
